subject.title: feat(autoreview): default Codex reviews to GPT-5.6 Sol

question: Should autoreview’s unpinned Codex default move from GPT-5.5 to the quality-first `gpt-5.6-sol` model for all users?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but an implicit default deliberately selects quality, cost, latency, and availability tradeoffs for existing users.

options.title: Adopt Sol default
options.body: Use `gpt-5.6-sol` as the quality-first default and retain existing CLI and environment overrides for users needing another tradeoff.

options.title: Use the family alias
options.body: Default to `gpt-5.6` so the upstream catalog controls the flagship route instead of pinning the concrete Sol slug.

options.title: Keep GPT-5.5
options.body: Leave the implicit default unchanged until maintainers have comparative cost, latency, and availability evidence.

recommendation.title: Adopt Sol default
recommendation.body: Use `gpt-5.6-sol` as the quality-first default and retain existing CLI and environment overrides for users needing another tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the heaviest and most recent current-main ownership of autoreview, including the latest model and service-tier policy work.
